finalText:
I re-protected all 13 reservations from AA918, issued the vouchers they're owed, and sent each passenger one message with their new itinerary.

- **Free of charge:** No change fees or fare differences were charged. I found no bulletins in effect.
- **Order:** I worked through passengers by tier, then earliest booking date.
- **Original schedule:** I measured delay against the original arrival, ORD 13:40 on 3 Aug. Dev and Mo's original final arrival was BOS 18:55.

| Passenger | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|
| Chloe Park (R6103, platinum) | UA88 on 3 Aug, business, arrives 12:25 | none (arrives earlier) |
| Iris Vance (R6109, platinum) | UA88 on 3 Aug, upgraded to premium economy, arrives 12:25 | none (arrives earlier) |
| Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (R6110, R6111, group, gold) | AA204 on 3 Aug, economy, together, arrive 15:15 | none (under 3 hours late) |
| Ben Okafor (R6102, gold) | DL512 on 3 Aug, economy, arrives 18:40 | $150 compensation |
| Farid Haddad (R6106, gold) | UA88 on 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 12:25 | none (arrives earlier) |
| Lea Sorensen (R6112, gold) | AA204 on 3 Aug, upgraded to business, arrives 15:15 | none (under 3 hours late) |
| Dev Mehta (R6104, silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug (arrives 23:50), then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 4 Aug (09:00, arrives 12:25) | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Mo Farah (R6113, silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug (arrives 23:50), then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 4 Aug (09:00, arrives 12:25) | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108, silver) | AA210 on 3 Aug, economy, arrives 23:50 | $300 compensation |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | $240 compensation (capped at her $240 fare), $180 hotel |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Elena Fox (R6105) | AA204 on 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 15:15 | none (under 3 hours late) |

- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were the only upgrades. Each is a gold or platinum passenger travelling alone on one flight, and each got a flight that gets them to Chicago sooner than anything left in their own cabin. I did not upgrade Ben, because the premium seat on UA88 was already taken. I did not upgrade Jun and Kofi, because group bookings are never upgraded.
- **Dev and Mo:** The AA204 and later arrivals break their AA1402 connection, so I also rebooked their onward leg. The AA210 arrival is the soonest that still makes a valid connection: the next morning's AA1410.
- **Request queue:** I didn't touch the request queue, because the task didn't mention it.
- **Dates:** Today is 2026-10-06, after the 3 Aug travel date. I followed the task as written and made the changes anyway.
